note: Extended from the four SROIE Task 3 targets (company, date, address, total) to every extractable value on this car-park exit ticket. The four-field schema captures almost nothing of what a parking-ticket pipeline needs; added the GST number, telephone, terminal/receipt code, the 14-character receipt number, the entry/exit timestamp pair, the duration and its printed format mask, the payment kind and the fee/GST/amount breakdown. All values corroborated by 11-14 of the 14 saved engine outputs. Judgement calls: (1) the ticket prints entry and exit as separate date+time pairs, so they are split into four fields rather than folded into the single dataset 'date'; the dataset value '23.03.18' is preserved unchanged as 'date'. (2) 'park_duration_format' is the literal mask 'D:HH:MM' printed on the page, kept because it is printed text a reader must not confuse with a value. (3) The bold '3180301' at the very top sits on the white scan background above the paper edge, not on the receipt; it is an archival label, so it is excluded — as is the equivalent annotation on sroie_001.
